scope.summary: The old target cannot exercise the new magicless streaming format: it creates a DStream in the default format and never sets its format before decompression. blockers.requirement: Configure the target's DStream with ZSTD_f_zstd1_magicless before decoding magicless frames, while retaining ordinary frame coverage.
blockers.target_route: LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput creates and initializes a DStream, then passes fuzz bytes to ZSTD_decompressStream. The same decoder context supports ZSTD_DCtx_setFormat before decompression.
blockers.failure_condition: For a finite valid magicless frame, the target leaves format at ZSTD_f_zstd1. The header parser therefore requires the ordinary magic number and returns prefix_unknown; no input byte can set the context format.
blockers.alternative_paths: Reset preserves the format, initialization sets the ordinary default, and the target has no format-setting call. Generic decompression is an alias of the same stream operation and supplies no automatic format detection.
